variable.name: GRAPH_MODE
variable.abstract: It adjusts the depth of colour that will be used

description.p: This variable indicates if the program uses a depth of colour of 8 or 16 bits. To indicate that the program uses a depth of 16 bits his value must be 1, for 8 bits his value must be 0. The default value is 0 (depth of 8 bits). Too can be indicated the use of 2XScale filter (only available for previous modes at 400x400 pixels).

The value of this variable (to use 16 bits) must be indicated before calling to the function .
If you want to use both constants, simply use: "graph_mode = mode_16bits | mode_2xscale ;".
